description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, V LONGBINARY); Close. Then 1 session(s), each adding one row through a table recordset (AddNew, ID, V, Update) and closing: IDs 1-1 with V a Long Binary of 3500 patterned bytes (index * 7 + 3, modulo 256). Pages 42-53 are read after the create session and after each insert session, and FieldSize read back at the end. Asks where each value is placed (inline in the row, a single LVAL row, chained pages) and which page it takes.
retentionNote: r-q19-growth-open (zfrp stretch 4 open growth cases): designed probe, one element varied; answers kept with their page bytes
